summary: Practise workstation evidence handling, Autopsy examination and forensic reporting. Explore the five-day computer forensics course.
lede: Computer forensic investigation training gives IT support specialists, security analysts and investigators a structured way to examine workstation evidence. You practise documenting and preserving evidence, verifying forensic images with SHA-256, reviewing Windows and browser artefacts in Autopsy, and separating observations from interpretation in traceable reports. Hands-on work focuses on foundational workstation investigations, with advanced memory analysis covered only at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for staff who handle, examine or report on computer evidence as part of workstation investigations. It suits beginners who use computers at work and need a disciplined foundation in evidence integrity and artefact review.
prerequisites: Basic computer use and familiarity with Windows files and folders. No coding or programming is required.
